business_summary.text: Rajratan Global Wire Limited is a leading bead wire manufacturer with a capacity of 72,000 TPA in India and 60,000 TPA in Thailand, supplying to tyre majors across PV, CV, two-wheeler and off-the-road segments.

call_points.text: Thailand operations are adding 50,000 TPA capacity within one year with a capex of ₹125 Cr.
Thailand operations adding 50,000 TPA capacity within one year to reach 1,10,000 TPA total capacity.
Export volumes from India grew by 38-40% YoY in Q2FY27 supported by multinational customers in Europe and Americas.
Focus on market share growth and volume-led strategy to improve efficiencies
Disciplined capital allocation to generate sustainable growth
Chennai plant capacity is being expanded to 60,000 tons by Q2 FY27 with an additional capex of INR 25 crores.
EBITDA margin is expected to return to normal levels of 13% to 13.5% in the current quarter as raw material price hikes are passed on.
